digest.component_or_area: Bridge runner orchestration and provider integration
propositions: Bridge orchestration must be packaged as runner-neutral Python core and exposed through Python library (rebar.bridge_run), CLI (rebar bridge run --profile), and MCP (write-gated bridge_run tool) interfaces.

Five execution profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) must map to legacy rebar commands while accepting new canonical 'profile' noun and preserving legacy MODE environment variable for provider compatibility.
The wheel must be deployable and functional from pip, Homebrew wheel-backed, and MCP Registry/uvx install paths without requiring repository-local scripts or unshipped code.
Legacy direct reconcile callers must retain published benign results (3/4/75); provider runner must translate benign results to canonical 0 while preserving operational 1 and invalid-invocation 2.

Provider wrappers (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab) must invoke installed rebar bridge run CLI with schema validation and embedded shell linted against pinned ShellCheck; GitLab schema must include immutable upstream revision and SHA-256 provenance.

Repository-local runner script is replaced by installed wheel entrypoint; explicit repo_root parameter overrides inherited REBAR_ROOT; every successful non-paused pass invokes strict delivery with run id and bot identity.
